INSERT INTO categorie (id, nome, parent_id) VALUES
(1, 'Elettronica', NULL),
(2, 'Computer', 1),
(3, 'Smartphone', 1),
(4, 'Accessori', 2),
(5, 'Abbigliamento', NULL);
query: WITH gerarchia_completa AS ( SELECT c.id AS categoria_id, c.nome AS categoria, p.nome AS categoria_padre, COUNT(s.id) AS numero_sottocategorie FROM categorie c LEFT JOIN categorie p ON c.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN categorie s ON s.parent_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nome, p.nome HAVING COUNT(s.id) >= 1 ) SELECT gc.categoria, gc.categoria_padre, gc.numero_sottocategorie, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY gc.numero_sottocategorie DESC) AS posizione FROM gerarchia_completa gc ORDER BY gc.numero_sottocategorie DESC, gc.categoria ASC LIMIT 10;
